agent_messages.content:
10 May – Counter Terrorism Policing arrest a man and a woman on suspicion of conspiracy to commit arson following an attack at the former East London Central Synagogue in Whitechapel. Police say the incident is being investigated alongside several apparent attacks on Jewish sites in London since late March.
Five men are injured in a series of suspected anti-Muslim attacks across Edinburgh. A 36-year-old man is later charged in connection with the incidents, with counter-terrorism officers supporting the investigation.
Counter terrorism police take over the Ann Widdecombe murder investigation.
A 25-year-old dual UK-Iranian national becomes the sixth person arrested in connection with the suspected terrorist activity near RAF Fairford, on suspicion of preparation of terrorist acts. Counter Terrorism Policing says it is investigating possible foreign state involvement.

In May 2026, Counter Terrorism Policing investigated a variety of incidents, including an attack on the former East London Central Synagogue, where a man and a woman were arrested on suspicion of conspiracy to commit arson. Additionally, there were investigations into a series of suspected anti-Muslim attacks in Edinburgh and the investigation into suspected terrorist activity near RAF Fairford. This included the arrest of a dual UK-Iranian national on suspicion of preparation of terrorist acts. 

FINAL: Counter Terrorism Policing investigated attacks on Jewish sites, anti-Muslim incidents, and suspect activities near RAF Fairford.
